clue.text: Primates heard sombre recordings

indicators.note: heard tells us the phrase for sombre recordings is to be said out loud, not written

parts.note: sombre colours are dull and grey; audio recordings are made on tapes

explanation.surface: Monkeys and apes listen to gloomy music.
explanation.walkthrough: Spoken, 'grey tapes' runs together into the same sounds as the two-word answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Gorillas, chimpanzees and orang-utans are the large tailless members of the primate order.

clue.text: Were friends boarded?

definitions.meaning: people who got along well together were on good terms
to have boarded a bus or train is to have climbed aboard it

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb has both senses: had a good relationship, and stepped aboard a vehicle.

clue.text: Horse nearly mated with buffalo on particular day, twice a year

indicators.note: nearly means the word for horse is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: equine is the adjective for a horse, used here as a noun for one
a buffalo is a kind of ox

explanation.surface: A horse is crossed with a buffalo on some special date that comes round twice a year.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nearly' drops the final E of EQUINE, leaving EQUIN.
explanation.definitionFit: The two dates each year when day and night are of equal length, in March and September.

clue.text: Sailor captured air force with a long, empty battle

indicators.note: a sailor who has captured things holds them within, so the sailor's word goes around the rest

parts.note: tar is an old word for a seaman
RAF is the Royal Air Force

indicators.note: an empty word has lost its inside, keeping only its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A seaman takes prisoner an air force unit, after a long and fruitless fight.
explanation.walkthrough: A tar is old slang for a sailor; 'empty' leaves only the ends of 'long'.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1805 sea battle off Spain where Nelson's fleet beat the French and Spanish.

clue.text: In the first half, Prince and Madonna achieve success as divas

indicators.note: achieve here works as a joining word, the pop star's name gaining what follows
In the first half keeps only the opening three of the six letters of Prince

parts.note: the pop singer's name, taken as written
S is a recognised abbreviation for success

explanation.surface: Two pop stars hit the big time early as temperamental singers.
explanation.walkthrough: PRI is half of Prince; the solver must accept S for success, a dictionary abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Leading female opera singers, or by extension temperamental, self-important performers.

clue.text: Blood sucker

definitions.meaning: the vital juice of a plant, likened to the life fluid running through a body
a sucker is a gullible person, a fool easily taken in

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a plant's vital fluid, figuratively its lifeblood, and a dupe or fool.

clue.text: Hunts for king in Lincoln or Chester, perhaps

indicators.note: in tells us the letter for king sits inside the word for the two cities

parts.note: Lincoln and Chester are cathedral cities, each the seat of a bishop's see
K is the abbreviation for king, as in chess

explanation.surface: Someone tracks down a king in one of two old English cities.
explanation.walkthrough: A see is a bishop's diocese; Lincoln and Chester are examples, so together sees.
explanation.definitionFit: To look for something is to search or seek it, as a hunter does.

clue.text: Rock film doesn't end

indicators.note: doesn't end means the word for film loses its last letter

parts.note: the screen stands for the cinema or films in general

explanation.surface: A rock movie that never finishes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doesn't end' drops the final N of SCREEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Loose broken stones on a mountain slope are a kind of rock debris.

clue.text: Destruction of the natural environment by melting ice cowed world at first — was ignored

indicators.note: melting suggests things losing their shape, so the letters are rearranged
was ignored says a letter is left out of the word cowed
at first picks out the opening letter of world

explanation.surface: The world is being wrecked as ice melts, a cowed planet's plight overlooked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'was ignored' takes W (first of world) out of COWED, leaving COED; 'melting' rearranges ICE and COED.
explanation.definitionFit: A coined word for wholesale ruin of ecosystems, built like genocide from eco- plus -cide.

clue.text: Correctly following spelling of "vivacious"

indicators.note: following means the word for correctly comes after the abbreviation

parts.note: correctly means rightly

explanation.surface: Someone checks how to spell a word meaning lively.
explanation.definitionFit: Lively and full of energy, as a sprite might be.

clue.text: Snatch of bright sun amid stormy sea

indicators.note: Snatch of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A glimpse of sunshine breaks through amid rough seas.
explanation.definitionFit: A giant destructive wave, here loosely described as violent water.

clue.text: Sitting room has mean, dirty look

parts.note: par is the average or mean level
to lour is to scowl, and a lour is a frown or dirty look

explanation.surface: A lounge where someone mean glowers.
explanation.definitionFit: An old-fashioned name for a front room where guests were received.

clue.text: Assassin nearly injured numerous judges and leaders

indicators.note: leaders are the front letters of the preceding words

explanation.surface: A killer has hurt many judges and leaders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaders' takes the first letters of nearly, injured, numerous, judges and and.
explanation.definitionFit: A Japanese mercenary trained in stealth and covert killing.

clue.text: Inside canvas shelter, cook avoids using black kindling

indicators.note: Inside says what follows is placed within the word for the shelter

parts.note: an awning is a canvas sheet stretched over a window or doorway

indicators.note: avoids using means a letter is dropped from the word for cook

parts.note: to bake is to cook in an oven
B is the pencil abbreviation for black

explanation.surface: A camper cooks under the tent flap without charcoal to light the fire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'kindling' here is the noun of stirring up, as an interest or feeling is kindled, not firewood.
explanation.definitionFit: Kindling here is the verb sense: arousing or stirring up, as of interest or a feeling.

clue.text: Obliterates this alien with an explosion

indicators.note: an explosion blows things apart, so the letters fly into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone destroys an extraterrestrial with a blast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'explosion' rearranges the eleven letters of THIS ALIEN and AN.
explanation.definitionFit: To wipe out completely, destroying every trace.

clue.text: Power steer causes disease

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for power
a steer is a castrated bullock, a kind of ox

explanation.surface: A strong bull carries illness.
explanation.definitionFit: An old name for various illnesses with skin eruptions, such as smallpox.

clue.text: Catspaw has to be timid

definitions.meaning: read literally, the foot of a cat
to act warily and avoid committing oneself

explanation.definitionFit: Split into its parts it is a cat's foot; as a verb it means to tread cautiously and evasively.

clue.text: It could be these provide protection for campers

parts.note: read as wordplay, the answer's two words say grind up the word sheet, and a shuffled sheet could be the word these

explanation.surface: A remark that certain items keep people under canvas safe.
explanation.walkthrough: A reverse clue: ground is an anagram indicator (past tense of grind), so the answer's words instruct a rearrangement of SHEET, which can give THESE.
explanation.definitionFit: A waterproof sheet spread under a tent shields those camping from damp earth.

clue.text: Allure of French department on the periphery

indicators.note: on the periphery means the word for department wraps around the French word

parts.note: a section is a department or division
du is French for of the

explanation.surface: The charm of some region of France out in the provinces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'French' modifies 'of' only, not 'department': the surface wants a French administrative département.
explanation.definitionFit: Enticement or temptation, the power to attract and lure.

clue.text: Like a cloudless day at the beginning of summer and dry?

indicators.note: at the beginning of picks out the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: something not soaked through is not drenched

explanation.surface: A clear day at the start of a dry summer.
explanation.walkthrough: S starts summer; UNDRENCHED is a literal opposite of soaked.
explanation.definitionFit: A day without clouds is flooded with bright sunlight.

clue.text: Does evening wear almost match?

parts.note: nigh means nearly or almost
a tie is a game or match, as in a cup tie

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether their evening outfit is almost a perfect match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'evening' tempts you towards NIGHT, but NIGH comes from 'almost'.
explanation.definitionFit: A loose garment women wear in bed, worn in the evening and overnight.

clue.text: Pitch was guarded

definitions.meaning: to pitch is to throw or toss, as at a fairground coconut stall
guarded means reserved or bashful in company

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a throw, as in a coconut shy, and also timid and reserved.

clue.text: Soldiers take him one piece of raw fish

parts.note: the SAS is the Special Air Service, a British army regiment
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Troops grab a man and a slice of uncooked seafood.
explanation.definitionFit: A Japanese dish of thinly cut uncooked fish.

clue.text: Engineer gilds gray tree, according to legend

indicators.note: to engineer is to construct or contrive, so the letters are rebuilt

explanation.surface: Someone sets about gilding a grey tree from mythology.
explanation.definitionFit: In Norse myth, the giant ash tree linking the nine worlds.

clue.text: Quite a few turn from left to right in streets

indicators.note: turn from left to right means the L letter is changed into an R

parts.note: loads means many or quite a few

explanation.surface: Many people turn right off the main street.
explanation.walkthrough: L and R stand for left and right, so LOADS becomes ROADS.
explanation.definitionFit: Streets are the paved ways along which traffic runs.

clue.text: Function of company secretary

explanation.surface: Someone asks what a firm's secretary is for.
explanation.definitionFit: Short for cosecant, a trigonometric ratio, which is a mathematical function.

clue.text: Aqueduct made from tin and aluminium

parts.note: a tin is a can
Al is the chemical symbol for aluminium

explanation.surface: A water channel built of metal.
explanation.definitionFit: An artificial waterway, a channel built to carry water.

clue.text: Barbarity and torture initially permitted in modern times

indicators.note: permitted in means one letter is let inside the phrase for modern times

parts.note: our age is the present era, modern times

indicators.note: initially picks out the opening letter of torture

explanation.surface: Cruelty and torment have been sanctioned in the present day.
explanation.walkthrough: T, from 'torture initially', is let into OUR AGE.
explanation.definitionFit: An atrocity or grossly cruel act is a barbarous deed.

clue.text: First person to state view

indicators.note: to state means to say the pronoun out loud

parts.note: I is the first person singular pronoun

explanation.surface: The first person to put forward an opinion.
explanation.definitionFit: Eye can mean sight or view, as in 'in my eye' or 'to the eye'.

clue.text: Sixth sense is lacking in practice

indicators.note: is lacking means the following word is taken away from the word for sixth sense

parts.note: intuition is a sixth sense, knowing without reasoning
taken as written

explanation.surface: In practice, a sixth sense is missing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is lacking' removes IN from the front of INTUITION.
explanation.definitionFit: Teaching or instruction, the coaching through which a skill is practised.

clue.text: Hair tie is missing but …

indicators.note: is missing means the word but is taken out of the structural word

parts.note: a tie in building is a beam or rod bracing a structure, as a buttress braces a wall

explanation.surface: A ponytail band has gone astray, but the sentence trails off into the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: A buttress loses BUT from its front. The ellipsis links this clue's surface to 28 across.
explanation.definitionFit: A lock or long curl of a person's hair is called by this poetic word.

clue.text: … oil might be organic

definitions.meaning: an oil distilled from a plant that keeps its scent, as used in aromatherapy
organic in the sense of fundamental, part of a thing's basic structure

explanation.definitionFit: The word describes the fragrant oils of aromatherapy and also means inherent or indispensable.
